summary: Current user policy is role-fit free-model eligibility rather than Gemini-only. Models may be introduced, tested, classified by task fitness, and used as explicit fallbacks when they are demonstrably suitable for the assigned role. Every attempt must preserve the actual provider/model identity and result; no silent downgrade. Groq is explicitly denied, including indirect selection through aggregators, until the user reverses that instruction.
evidence_refs: Current user instruction in Chat, 2026-09-22: 'Best can mean any model meant for this work well.'
Current user instruction in Chat, 2026-09-22: free models are acceptable as backup and should be tested/rated by task.
Current user instruction in Chat, 2026-09-22: 'NO GROQ' / vibe-banned until further notice.
counterevidence: Earlier instruction required best eligible Gemini only and no weaker fallback; the later user clarification supersedes that narrower interpretation while retaining no-silent-downgrade and explicit model identity.
limitations: This resolves policy, not provider eligibility. Exact model IDs, quotas, terms and role fitness still require current verification and testing before live use.
It does not authorize paid resources or hidden upstream providers.
